evidence: Static review finds no contract defect. solve.sh: #!/bin/bash shebang (line 1), LF only (0 CR bytes), bash -n clean, mkdir -p /app (4), cp -a "$source_app/." /app/ (38); it writes only under /app, nothing to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, no NODE_ENV, no npm/curl/wget install. The only deviation from the 5-line template solve.sh is a guarded reset (lines 8-37) that refuses to delete /app/app.db{,-wal,-shm} while any process holds them open and then removes them, making reinstall idempotent. Entry /app/server.js is created (test.sh:68 requires it; test.sh:111 launches node "$APP_ENTRY"). server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (lines 2-5), both pinned in environment/Dockerfile:9-11 and tests/Dockerfile:20-21 and resolved through NODE_PATH; there is no /app/node_modules and no symlink, so the test.sh:72-83 symlink refusal cannot trigger. DB_PATH is honoured first with a __dirname default of /app/app.db (server.js:8), files resolve from __dirname (7,130,131) so cwd outside /app and the /tmp/submission copy both work; it listens on 0.0.0.0 and PORT||3000 (142), answers GET /api/health before the database opens (12); schema is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / INSERT OR IGNORE (147-168) and no rows are seeded, matching integration.md:7. The frontend ships prebuilt in public/assets (index.js 1.9 MB, index.css) with no build or install at start and the CSP is default-src 'self' (16); the only absolute URLs in the bundle are XML namespaces and library doc strings. test.sh, environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template. Measured evidence (hashes verified): run_golden.sh runs `bash /solution/solve.sh` in a clean agent-image container, starts `cd / && node /app/server.js`, and results/restart.json plus persist-after.json show cw_save_reload_restart true across a real process replacement. Gap: the raw-evidence index itself states that the app ran as root without DB_PATH, so the actual verifier launch path (test.sh:104-111: env -i, uid/gid 65534, HOME=/tmp/submission, DB_PATH=/app/app.db, WAL sidecar creation in a chowned /app, plus the restart helper at 160-167) has not been executed on these bytes. That is required runtime evidence for 'the reference runs under the stated contract' and stays an open risk; this Note does not waive it.
